verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships fixed, built-in automations—PR pushes trigger automatic reviews (foreloop-docs-1, foreloop-docs-25) and feedback submissions automatically spawn intentions via an agent (foreloop-docs-10, foreloop-docs-21)—but there is no evidence of a general rule-definition system where users specify arbitrary event-condition-action rules. missing for 10: user-configurable trigger definitions, conditional logic beyond fixed platform events, and evidence of a rules/automation engine rather than hardcoded behaviors.
